#### Expected Behavior
The expected behavior is that unqualified names in `:type:` and `:rtype:` fields should resolve to the correct class within the current module or its parent modules, without generating ambiguous class lookup warnings.

The root cause of the issue lies in the `make_xref` method of the `PyTypedField` class in `sphinx/domains/python.py`.
